verdict.rationale: Runway documents text-only video generation via Gen-4.5 (`POST /v1/text_to_video`) and its app as a 'video generator from text, an image or a clip.' For iteration, a cheap `draft: true` preview can be enhanced to 1080p by referencing its `draftTaskId`, and generated clips can be refined through video-to-video editing (Aleph 2.0) rather than regenerating from scratch. Missing for 10: documentation of a creator-facing iteration workflow in the app (prompt refinement or version history on an existing clip), and independent or hands-on corroboration of prompt-to-video iteration.
